points: The bill would let authorities reroute or record traffic, change or delete data and intervene in DNS
eco wants a judge's approval beyond private systems and thresholds that rise with severity
Statement follows the Bundestag interior committee hearing on 5 October
take: Germany's draft cybersecurity law gives authorities active-defence powers that could hit uninvolved firms' systems. Operators and hosting providers should follow the revision.
title: eco: German cyber bill lets authorities intervene in networks
